guardrails: An `unclear` or abstained answer goes to a human; it is scored as wrong, so abstaining is never free.
The schema-valid rate must stay at or above 98%.
Never auto-close, auto-send or auto-approve a model answer; a person makes the final call.
recheck_trigger: `wam recheck run --tasks T-REPLY --against results/runs/live` when a new model is released, when a model changes under the same id, or after a prompt change (that needs a new baseline run first).
title: Draft a structured reply
when_to_use: Turn a customer message into one typed object: intent, urgency and reply text.
